```markdown
  type: user | feedback | project | reference
---

<the fact; for feedback/project, follow with **Why:** and **How to apply:** lines. Link related memories with [[their-name]].>
```

In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

# Environment
 - The most recent Claude models are the Claude 5 family. Model IDs — Fable 5.1: 'claude-fable-5-1', Opus 5.5: 'claude-opus-5-5', Sonnet 5.5: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', Haiku 5.5: 'claude-haiku-5-5'. When building AI applications, default to the latest and most capable Claude models.
 - Claude Code is available as a CLI in the terminal, desktop app (Mac/Windows), web app (claude.ai/code), and IDE extensions (VS Code, JetBrains).
 - Fast mode for Claude Code uses Claude Opus with faster output (it does not downgrade to a smaller model). It can be toggled with /fast.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

180	### 4.2 读写机制：property 三件套与 set_data / get
181	
182	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
183	
184	`Det3DDataSample` 没有普通的 `__init__` 参数列表，所有字段都通过 **property（属性）三件套**——getter、setter、deleter——来读写。这样设计有两个目的：
185	
186	1. **类型防线**：setter 内部调用 `set_field(value, '_xxx', dtype=InstanceData)`，赋值时立刻断言类型，把「塞错容器」的错误从「训练到一半才崩」提前到「赋值那一行」。
187	2. **下划线隔离**：真实数据存在 `_gt_instances_3d` 这类私有字段里，`gt_instances_3d` 只是访问入口，避免用户绕过检查直接改内部状态。
188	
189	更底层的通用读写由 MMEngine 的 `BaseDataElement` 提供：`set_data(dict)` 批量写、`get(key, default)` 安全读、`set_metainfo(dict)` 写元信息区。mmdet3d 自己的代码两种风格都在用。

191	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
192	
193	```text
194	写入一条 3D 真值：
195	data_sample.gt_instances_3d = InstanceData(...)
196	    → property setter
197	    → self.set_field(value, '_gt_instances_3d', dtype=InstanceData)
198	    → 断言 value 是 InstanceData，登记进 _data_fields
199	
200	批量写入（分割后处理风格）：
201	data_sample.set_data({'pred_pts_seg': PointData(...), ...})
202	    → 逐键走 setattr，落到对应分区
203	
204	读取：
205	data_sample.gt_instances_3d      # 属性风格
206	data_sample['gt_instances_3d']   # 下标风格（KittiMetric 就这么用）
207	data_sample.get('sample_idx')    # 带默认值的读
208	
209	删除：
210	del data_sample.gt_instances_3d  → deleter 删私有字段并注销登记
211	```

266	### 4.3 PointData：点级标注与预测的容器
267	
268	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
269	
270	`InstanceData` 的世界是「一个实例一行」；`PointData` 的世界是「一个点一行」。3D 语义分割任务里，一帧 10 万个点各有各的语义标签和实例编号，这些一维、等长的数组需要一个专门容器——这就是 `PointData`。它在 `Det3DDataSample` 中占据 `gt_pts_seg` 与 `pred_pts_seg` 两个字段。
271	
272	`PointData` 的两条铁律（docstring 明确写出）：所有 data field 必须**都是一维的**、且**长度相同**（都等于点数）。这使它能像张量的第一维那样被整体索引。
273	
274	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
275	
276	```text
277	写入：point_data.pts_semantic_mask = tensor(N,)   → __setattr__ 校验有 __len__
278	索引：point_data[bool 掩码 / LongTensor / 切片 / int]
279	    → __getitem__ 对每个字段并行取同一批索引，返回新 PointData
280	长度：len(point_data) = 第一个 data field 的长度
281	```
282	
283	`__getitem__` 是 `PointData` 最有意思的部分：无论传入布尔掩码、索引张量、切片还是整数，它都会**对容器内所有字段施加同一次筛选**，返回一个携带相同 metainfo 的新 `PointData`。这个能力和 `InstanceData` 的按实例筛选同源——数据增强或后处理中「只保留前景点」时，一条索引语句就能同步裁剪语义掩码与实例掩码。
284	
285	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
286	
287	**类定义与官方范例**。[mmdet3d/structures/point_data.py:L14-L46](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/structures/point_data.py#L14-L46)：docstring 给出最小示例——100 个点的 `PointData`，`point_data[10:60]` 切片后长度变为 50，随后补写 `pts_semantic_mask`/`pts_instance_mask` 两个 `(100,)` 张量。
288	
289	**写入校验**。[mmdet3d/structures/point_data.py:L48-L67](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/structures/point_data.py#L48-L67)：`__setattr__` 先保护 `_metainfo_fields`/`_data_fields` 两个内部名单不可被覆盖，再断言新值必须实现 `__len__`（L62-L63 的 `isinstance(value, Sized)`），否则拒绝写入；L67 让 `point_data['key'] = value` 与属性赋值等价。

343	### 4.4 data_sample 的完整生命周期：生产、消费、评估
344	
345	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
346	
347	单看字段定义还不足以理解契约，必须看它在流水线三个环节里被谁写、被谁读：
348	
349	- **生产**：`Pack3DDetInputs`（数据管线最后一个 transform，u3-l8 会专门精读）把增强后的 `results` dict 拆成 `inputs` 与 `data_samples`；
350	- **读写**：模型在 `loss` 模式读真值、在 `predict` 模式写预测；
351	- **消费**：评估器把 `pred_instances_3d` 与 `sample_idx` 收进结果列表。
352	
353	理解这条链路后，你读任何检测器/评估器代码都能立刻对上「它在碰契约的哪个字段」。
354	
355	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
356	
357	```text
358	pack_single_results(results) 的分流规则（formating.py）：
359	  INPUTS_KEYS       ('points','img')        → inputs
360	  INSTANCEDATA_3D_KEYS (gt_bboxes_3d 等)    → gt_instances_3d（去掉 gt_ 前缀）
361	  INSTANCEDATA_2D_KEYS (gt_bboxes 等)       → gt_instances
362	  SEG_KEYS          (pts_*_mask 等)         → gt_pts_seg
363	  meta_keys         (sample_idx 等 38 项)   → data_sample.set_metainfo
364	
365	预测写入（detectors/base.py）：
366	  head 产出 results_list（每个元素键名 bboxes_3d/scores_3d/labels_3d，
367	  由 bbox3d2result 统一组装）
368	  → add_pred_to_datasample 逐样本写入
369	    data_sample.pred_instances_3d / data_sample.pred_instances
370	
371	评估消费（kitti_metric.py）：
372	  for data_sample in data_samples:
373	      读 data_sample['pred_instances_3d'] → 逐字段 .to('cpu')
374	      读 data_sample['sample_idx']（来自 metainfo）
375	      存入 self.results，最终由 compute_metrics 换算 AP
376	```
377	
378	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
379	
380	**字段分流的「路由表」**。[mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py:L50-L62](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L50-L62) 定义四组键名单：`INPUTS_KEYS`、`INSTANCEDATA_3D_KEYS`、`INSTANCEDATA_2D_KEYS`、`SEG_KEYS`——4.4.2 流程图里的分流规则就是查这四张表。[L64-L80](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L64-L80) 的 `meta_keys` 默认值列出约 38 个元信息键（`lidar2img`、`box_type_3d`、`sample_idx`、`pcd_scale_factor`……），相当于契约 metainfo 区的官方清单。
381	
382	**生产现场**。[mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py:L194-L221](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L194-L221)：先 `new` 出 `Det3DDataSample()` 与三个空容器（`InstanceData`×2 + `PointData`），再按 `meta_keys` 从 results（含 `images`/`lidar_points` 嵌套 dict 的兼容分支）收集元信息调用 `set_metainfo`。[L223-L245](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L223-L245)：遍历 `self.keys` 查路由表分发，注意 `gt_bboxes_3d` 进来时若不是框容器会被 `to_tensor` 转成裸张量（L184-L186），`gt_` 前缀被 `_remove_prefix` 剥掉（L84-L87）——所以契约里的键名是 `bboxes_3d` 而管线里的键名是 `gt_bboxes_3d`。最后 [L246-L255](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L246-L255) 写入 `eval_ann_info`（无则 `None`），返回 `dict(data_samples=..., inputs=...)`——这就是 DataLoader 拿到的最终形态。
383	
384	**三模式入口**。[mmdet3d/models/detectors/base.py:L74-L91](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/detectors/base.py#L74-L91)：`forward` 按 `mode` 分发到 `loss`/`predict`/`_forward`；`predict` 分支还识别 `data_samples[0]` 是 list 的「测试时增强」情形（u7-l4 的伏笔）。
385	
386	**训练消费**。[mmdet3d/models/detectors/single_stage.py:L56-L76](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/detectors/single_stage.py#L56-L76)：`loss(batch_inputs_dict, batch_data_samples)` 原封不动把整批 data_samples 传给 `bbox_head.loss`——真值的拆包发生在检测头内部（单元 5 精读 `get_targets` 时会看到它逐样本读 `gt_instances_3d`）。
387	
388	**预测写入**。[mmdet3d/models/detectors/single_stage.py:L109-L113](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/detectors/single_stage.py#L109-L113) 把 head 的 `results_list` 交给 `add_pred_to_datasample`；真正写契约的是 [mmdet3d/models/detectors/base.py:L149-L152](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/detectors/base.py#L149-L152)：循环里两行赋值 `data_sample.pred_instances_3d = ...` 与 `data_sample.pred_instances = ...`，缺哪一侧就用空 `InstanceData()` 补齐（L140-L147）。预测结果的统一键名来自 [mmdet3d/structures/ops/transforms.py:L51-L77](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/structures/ops/transforms.py#L51-L77) 的 `bbox3d2result`：返回 `dict(bboxes_3d=..., scores_3d=..., labels_3d=...)`（可选 `attr_labels`），全部先 `.to('cpu')`——评估器因此拿到的天然是 CPU 张量前的统一格式。
389	
390	**评估消费**。[mmdet3d/evaluation/metrics/kitti_metric.py:L145-L168](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/evaluation/metrics/kitti_metric.py#L145-L168)：`process` 逐样本读 `data_sample['pred_instances_3d']`（下标写法等价于属性访问）、逐字段 `.to('cpu')`，再从 metainfo 读 `data_sample['sample_idx']` 作为对齐真值的钥匙，最终append 进 `self.results`，供 `compute_metrics`（L170 起）换算 AP。
391	
392	**官方「范本数据」**。[mmdet3d/testing/model_utils.py:L124-L148](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/testing/model_utils.py#L124-L148)：mmdet3d 给单测造假数据的函数就是按契约组装——`InstanceData` 装 `bboxes_3d`+`labels_3d` 赋给 `gt_instances_3d`，`PointData` 装 `pts_instance_mask`/`pts_semantic_mask` 赋给 `gt_pts_seg`，metainfo 里放 `box_type_3d`。自己写测试或调试脚本时照抄这个结构即可。
393	
394	#### 4.4.4 代码实践
395	
396	**实践目标**：不装任何数据集，直接调用 `Pack3DDetInputs` 把一个手工 results dict 打包成 `{'inputs', 'data_samples'}`，亲眼看到契约被「生产」出来。
397	
398	**操作步骤**（示例代码）：
399	
400	```python
401	# 示例代码：绕过数据集，直接驱动 Pack3DDetInputs
402	import torch
403	from mmdet3d.datasets.transforms.formating import Pack3DDetInputs
404	from mmdet3d.structures import LiDARInstance3DBoxes, LiDARPoints
405	
406	results = dict(
407	    points=LiDARPoints(torch.rand(100, 4)),          # 100 点，4 通道
408	    gt_bboxes_3d=LiDARInstance3DBoxes(torch.rand(3, 7)),
409	    gt_labels_3d=torch.tensor([0, 0, 2]),
410	    sample_idx='000008',
411	    box_type_3d=LiDARInstance3DBoxes,
412	    lidar_path='data/kitti/training/velodyne/000008.bin',
413	)
414	
415	pack = Pack3DDetInputs(
416	    keys=('points', 'gt_bboxes_3d', 'gt_labels_3d'),
417	    meta_keys=('sample_idx', 'box_type_3d', 'lidar_path'))
418	packed = pack.transform(results)
419	
420	print('顶层键:', packed.keys())                        # dict_keys(['data_samples', 'inputs'])
421	print('inputs 键:', packed['inputs'].keys())           # ['points']，且已是裸 tensor
422	ds = packed['data_samples']
423	print(type(ds).__name__)                               # Det3DDataSample
424	print('真值字段:', ds.gt_instances_3d.keys())          # ['bboxes_3d', 'labels_3d']（前缀已剥）
425	print('sample_idx:', ds.get('sample_idx'))
426	print('points 形状:', packed['inputs']['points'].shape)  # torch.Size([100, 4])
427	```
428	
429	**需要观察的现象**：
430	
431	1. `packed` 只有两个顶层键：`data_samples` 与 `inputs`。
432	2. `inputs['points']` 已经从 `LiDARPoints` 对象变成了裸 `torch.Tensor`（formating.py:L144-L146 的降维）。
433	3. `gt_instances_3d` 内部的键是 `bboxes_3d`/`labels_3d`——`gt_` 前缀在打包时被剥掉。
434	4. `sample_idx` 不在 `keys()` 里而在 metainfo 区，`ds.get('sample_idx')` 才能取到。
435	
436	**预期结果**：以上 4 点均与 formating.py 的实现一一对应；具体张量数值随机，**待本地验证**。
437	
438	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
439	
440	**练习 1**：管线里键名是 `gt_bboxes_3d`，契约里却是 `bboxes_3d`，这层改名发生在哪里、为什么？
441	
442	**答案**：发生在 [formating.py:L84-L87](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L84-L87) 的 `_remove_prefix`，在写入 `gt_instances_3d[...]` 前剥掉 `gt_`。因为容器名 `gt_instances_3d` 已经表达了「这是真值」，内部字段再带 `gt_` 就冗余了；而 `pred_instances_3d` 复用同样的字段名 `bboxes_3d`，读写两侧因此对称。
443	
444	**练习 2**：`add_pred_to_datasample` 为什么要为缺失的一侧填空 `InstanceData()`（base.py:L140-L147）？
445	
446	**答案**：为了保证契约的完整性——每个输出 data_sample 都同时具有 `pred_instances_3d` 与 `pred_instances` 两个字段。纯点云模型没有 2D 预测，评估器（如 KittiMetric.process 同时读两者，kitti_metric.py:L158-L165）就不用判空，下游代码得以简化。
447	
448	**练习 3**：`KittiMetric.process` 用 `data_sample['sample_idx']` 对齐真值。这个键最初是谁写进 data_sample 的？
449	
450	**答案**：`Pack3DDetInputs` 在收集 metainfo 时写入（`meta_keys` 默认清单含 `sample_idx`，formating.py:L73；写入点在 L199-L221 的 `set_metainfo`）。数据集类的 `parse_data_info` 先在 results dict 里提供它（单元 3 展开）。
451	
452	## 5. 综合实践
453	
454	**任务：手工扮演一次「最小训练-推理-评估」回合，全程只用契约，不碰真实数据与模型。**
455	
456	把下面三段拼成一个脚本（示例代码），复现 4.1.2 主线图的每个环节：
457	
458	```python
459	# 示例代码：契约视角的迷你回合
460	import torch
461	from mmengine.structures import InstanceData
462	
463	from mmdet3d.datasets.transforms.formating import Pack3DDetInputs
464	from mmdet3d.evaluation.metrics.kitti_metric import KittiMetric
465	from mmdet3d.structures import Det3DDataSample, LiDARInstance3DBoxes, LiDARPoints
466	
467	# ── 环节 1：模拟数据管线出口 ──────────────────────────────
468	results = dict(
469	    points=LiDARPoints(torch.rand(100, 4)),
470	    gt_bboxes_3d=LiDARInstance3DBoxes(torch.rand(3, 7)),
471	    gt_labels_3d=torch.tensor([0, 0, 2]),
472	    sample_idx='000001', box_type_3d=LiDARInstance3DBoxes)
473	packed = Pack3DDetInputs(
474	    keys=('points', 'gt_bboxes_3d', 'gt_labels_3d'),
475	    meta_keys=('sample_idx', 'box_type_3d')).transform(results)
476	data_sample, inputs = packed['data_samples'], packed['inputs']
477	
478	# ── 环节 2：模拟模型 predict 写入预测（照抄 add_pred_to_datasample 的两行）──
479	fake_head_result = InstanceData(
480	    bboxes_3d=data_sample.gt_instances_3d.bboxes_3d[:2],
481	    scores_3d=torch.tensor([0.9, 0.8]),
482	    labels_3d=torch.tensor([0, 2]))
483	data_sample.pred_instances_3d = fake_head_result
484	data_sample.pred_instances = InstanceData()          # 2D 侧补空，保持契约完整
485	
486	# ── 环节 3：模拟评估器消费（复刻 KittiMetric.process 的读取方式）──
487	pred_3d = data_sample['pred_instances_3d']           # 下标读法与 KittiMetric 相同
488	pred_3d = {k: v.to('cpu') for k, v in pred_3d.items()}
489	record = dict(pred_instances_3d=pred_3d,
490	              sample_idx=data_sample['sample_idx'])
491	print('送入评估器的记录:', record)
492	
493	# ── 环节 4：模拟置信度过滤（评估/可视化常见操作）──
494	kept = fake_head_result[fake_head_result.scores_3d > 0.85]
495	print('过滤后实例数:', len(kept))                      # 预期 1（0.9 > 0.85）
496	```
497	
498	**验收标准**：脚本能跑通；环节 3 打出的 `record` 的键与 `KittiMetric.process`（kitti_metric.py:L156-L168）收集的键一致；环节 4 的过滤结果符合预期。张量数值与 `record` 的具体内容**待本地验证**。完成后回答：如果环节 2 少写 `pred_instances = InstanceData()`，环节 3 的代码会在哪一行以什么方式失败？（提示：`KittiMetric.process` 对 `pred_2d` 逐字段 `.to('cpu')`。）
499	
500	## 6. 本讲小结
501	
502	- `Det3DDataSample` 继承 mmdet 的 `DetDataSample`，用 property 三件套声明 `gt_instances_3d`/`pred_instances_3d`/`pts_pred_instances_3d`/`gt_pts_seg` 等字段，setter 的 `dtype` 断言就是契约的运行时防线。
503	- 实例级数据装 `InstanceData`（N 实例同长），点级数据装 `PointData`（N 点同长、全一维），`eval_ann_info` 是唯一的裸 dict 字段。
504	- metainfo 与 data fields 是两个独立分区：`sample_idx`、`box_type_3d`、`lidar2img` 等元信息由管线写入、由预处理器增补（`batch_input_shape`/`pad_shape`），全流程共享。
505	- 生命周期三步：`Pack3DDetInputs.pack_single_results` 按 four 张键名路由表生产 `dict(inputs, data_samples)`；模型 `loss` 模式读真值、`predict` 模式经 `add_pred_to_datasample` 写预测；评估器用 `data_sample['pred_instances_3d']` 与 `sample_idx` 消费结果。
506	- `gt_` 前缀在打包时被剥掉，因此真值容器与预测容器内部字段同名（`bboxes_3d`/`labels_3d`），读写对称；`bbox3d2result` 保证所有检测头的预测键名统一。
507	- 读写 API 三套等价通道：属性赋值（触发类型断言）、`set_data`（批量）、`set_metainfo`（元信息区）；`get`/`keys()`/`in` 用于安全读取。
508	
509	## 7. 下一步学习建议
510	
511	本讲完成了「数据结构」单元的最后一块拼图。下一步进入单元 3（数据集与数据管线）：
512	
513	1. **u3-l1 Det3DDataset 基类**：看 `parse_data_info` 如何为 `Pack3DDetInputs` 准备 results dict 里的每一个键——本讲 4.4 环节的上游。
514	2. **u3-l8 Pack3DDetInputs 专讲**：本讲只精读了它的分流骨架，那一讲会完整覆盖 `meta_keys` 全表、训练/测试两套打包差异。
515	3. 想先验证环境的读者，可以运行 `pytest tests/test_structures/ -v`，把本讲的三个结构（框、点、DataSample）的单测一起跑绿。
516	4. 阅读 [mmdet3d/testing/model_utils.py](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/testing/model_utils.py) 的完整 `create_data_sample` 函数——它是官方认可的「标准 data_sample 长什么样」的参考答案。

# Det3DDataSample：贯穿训练推理的数据契约

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出 `Det3DDataSample` 的全部字段（`gt_instances_3d`、`pred_instances_3d`、`gt_pts_seg`、`pts_pred_instances_3d` 等），并区分「实例级 3D 数据」「实例级 2D 数据」和「点级数据」三类容器。
2. 画出一条数据样本的完整生命周期：数据管线出口（`Pack3DDetInputs`）生产 → `data_preprocessor` 补充 metainfo → 模型 `loss`/`predict` 读写 → 评估器 `process` 消费。
3. 会用属性赋值、`set_data`、`set_metainfo`、`get`、`keys()` 这些读写接口手工构造和拆解一个 `Det3DDataSample`，并能解释 setter 背后的类型断言为什么存在。

## 2. 前置知识

**什么是「数据契约」。** 一个训练框架里有多种角色：DataLoader 负责喂数据、模型负责算损失和预测、评估器负责算指标、可视化器负责画图。如果每个角色都自定义一套数据格式，代码会迅速失控。「契约」就是所有角色共同遵守的一份字段约定——谁生产什么字段、谁消费什么字段，全部写死在一个类里。MMDetection3D 中这份契约就是 `Det3DDataSample`。

**BaseDataElement 与 InstanceData（来自 MMEngine）。** MMEngine 的 `structures` 模块提供了数据容器的基座：

- `BaseDataElement`：最通用容器，内部把字段分成两组——**metainfo（元信息）**与 **data fields（数据字段）**。它提供 `set_metainfo`、`set_data`、`get`、`keys()`、`values()`、`items()` 等读写接口，以及 `print` 时分层打印的友好 repr。
- `InstanceData`：继承自 `BaseDataElement`，专门存「一帧里 N 个实例」的数据（如 N 个框、N 个标签、N 个分数），约束是所有字段的第一个维度必须同为 N，因此支持用下标、切片、布尔掩码「按实例」筛选。

**本讲与前面两讲的衔接。** 前两讲我们已经掌握了契约里装的两个「重型货物」：

- `BaseInstance3DBoxes` 家族（u2-l2）：7 自由度 3D 框的张量包装类，`gt_instances_3d.bboxes_3d` 装的就是它；
- `BasePoints` 家族（u2-l3）：点云容器，但它只住在 `inputs['points']` 里，进不了 `data_samples`（后面会看到原因）。

本讲要回答的问题是：这些货物如何被打包、贴标签、在整条流水线上流转。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `mmdet3d/structures/det3d_data_sample.py` | **本讲主角**。定义 `Det3DDataSample` 及其全部字段的属性读写器 |
| `mmdet3d/structures/point_data.py` | 点级数据容器 `PointData`，承载点云分割的标注与预测 |
| `mmdet3d/structures/__init__.py` | structures 包的总出口，`Det3DDataSample`/`PointData` 从这里对外导出 |
| `mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py` | `Pack3DDetInputs`：数据管线的最后一个 transform，**生产** Det3DDataSample |
| `mmdet3d/models/detectors/base.py` | `Base3DDetector.forward` 三模式入口 + `add_pred_to_datasample`：把预测**写回** data_sample |
| `mmdet3d/models/detectors/single_stage.py` | 单阶段检测器的 `loss`/`predict`，展示 data_samples 的**消费**方式 |
| `mmdet3d/models/segmentors/base.py` | 分割模型后处理，展示 `set_data` 批量写入 `pred_pts_seg` |
| `mmdet3d/models/data_preprocessors/data_preprocessor.py` | 预处理器向 data_sample **追加** metainfo |
| `mmdet3d/evaluation/metrics/kitti_metric.py` | 评估器**读取** data_sample 的字段 |
| `mmdet3d/structures/ops/transforms.py` | `bbox3d2result`：检测头统一预测键名的工具函数 |
| `mmdet3d/testing/model_utils.py` | 官方测试用的「假 data_sample」构造器，是最好的模仿范本 |
| `tests/test_structures/test_det3d_data_sample.py` | Det3DDataSample 的单元测试，实践时直接运行 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 Det3DDataSample：3D 检测的数据契约本体

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`Det3DDataSample` 是一个纯粹的「字段声明」类：它本身几乎没有逻辑，只做两件事——声明 3D 生态需要哪些字段、为每个字段强制类型检查。它继承自 MMDetection 的 `DetDataSample`（2D 检测的契约），因此天然拥有 `proposals`、`ignored_instances`、`gt_instances`、`pred_instances` 这四个 2D 字段，再在之上**新增**了 3D 与点级字段。这个继承关系正是 u1-l1 讲过的「复用 MMDetection 组件」思想在数据结构上的体现。

为什么需要它？因为 3D 检测的输入输出形态比 2D 复杂得多：同一个模型可能既输出点云 3D 框又输出图像 2D 框（多模态），分割模型还要输出逐点标签。把这些字段全部标准化，下游的评估器和可视化器才能做到「一套代码适配所有模型」。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一条样本在框架中的完整旅程（本讲的主线图，后面各模块都会回到它）：

```text
数据集 pipeline 产出的 results dict（点、框、标签、各种 meta）
        │
        │  Pack3DDetInputs.pack_single_results   ← 生产：分流打包
        ▼
dict(inputs={'points', 'img'}, data_samples=Det3DDataSample)
        │
        │  DataLoader 组 batch → Det3DDataPreprocessor
        │  （向每个 data_sample 追加 batch_input_shape / pad_shape 等 metainfo）
        ▼
Base3DDetector.forward(inputs, data_samples, mode=...)
        ├── mode='loss'    → head.loss 读取 gt_instances_3d / gt_pts_seg 算损失
        ├── mode='predict' → head 产出 results_list，
        │                    add_pred_to_datasample 写入 pred_instances_3d / pred_instances
        └── mode='tensor'  → 只返回张量，不读写 data_samples
        │（predict 模式的输出：list[Det3DDataSample]）
        ▼
Evaluator.process（KittiMetric 读 pred_instances_3d + sample_idx）
Visualizer（读 pred_instances_3d + metainfo 画框）
```

字段分类总表（建议牢记，读任何 mmdet3d 代码都会反复遇到）：

| 字段 | 容器类型 | 谁生产 | 谁消费 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gt_instances_3d` | `InstanceData` | `Pack3DDetInputs`（数据管线） | 检测头 `loss`/`get_targets`（单元 5） |
| `gt_instances` | `InstanceData`（继承自 mmdet） | `Pack3DDetInputs` | 2D 分支损失、多模态评估 |
| `pred_instances_3d` | `InstanceData` | `add_pred_to_datasample` | 评估器、可视化器 |
| `pred_instances` | `InstanceData`（继承自 mmdet） | `add_pred_to_datasample` | 多模态 2D 评估 |
| `pts_pred_instances_3d` / `img_pred_instances_3d` | `InstanceData` | 多模态检测器 | 区分点云/图像来源的 3D 预测 |
| `gt_pts_seg` / `pred_pts_seg` | `PointData` | `Pack3DDetInputs` / 分割模型后处理 | 分割损失与指标 |
| `eval_ann_info` | `dict` 或 `None` | 数据集类 | 在线评估 |
| metainfo（`sample_idx`、`box_type_3d`、`lidar2img`…） | 任意 | `set_metainfo` | 全流程共享 |

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：不借助任何数据集和模型，手工构造一个「训练阶段视角」的 `Det3DDataSample`，并打印它的分层 repr，直观理解契约里装了什么。

**操作步骤**（以下为示例代码，可直接存成 `explore_data_sample.py` 在仓库根目录运行）：

```python
# 示例代码：手工构造 Det3DDataSample
import torch
from mmengine.structures import InstanceData

from mmdet3d.structures import (Det3DDataSample, LiDARInstance3DBoxes,
                                PointData)

# 1) 元信息：描述「这一帧」的背景，而非某个具体实例
metainfo = dict(
    sample_idx='000008',
    box_type_3d=LiDARInstance3DBoxes,   # 告诉下游 bboxes_3d 是哪个框类
    lidar_path='data/kitti/training/velodyne/000008.bin')

data_sample = Det3DDataSample(metainfo=metainfo)

# 2) 真值：3 个 KITTI 尺寸的车辆框（x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, yaw）
gt_bboxes_3d = LiDARInstance3DBoxes(torch.tensor([
    [10.0, -2.0, -1.20, 3.9, 1.6, 1.5, 0.50],
    [15.5,  1.0, -1.10, 4.2, 1.7, 1.5, -0.3],
    [20.0,  0.5, -1.05, 1.2, 0.9, 1.1, 1.20],   # 一个行人
]))
gt_instances_3d = InstanceData(
    bboxes_3d=gt_bboxes_3d,
    labels_3d=torch.tensor([0, 0, 2]),           # 0=Car, 2=Pedestrian
)
data_sample.gt_instances_3d = gt_instances_3d

# 3) 假装模型已经预测完：2 个带分数的预测
pred_instances_3d = InstanceData(
    bboxes_3d=LiDARInstance3DBoxes(gt_bboxes_3d.tensor[:2] + 0.1),  # 加偏移模拟误差
    scores_3d=torch.tensor([0.92, 0.61]),
    labels_3d=torch.tensor([0, 0]),
)
data_sample.pred_instances_3d = pred_instances_3d

# 4) 点级真值：3 个点上的分割掩码（演示 SEG 字段，长度=点数）
data_sample.gt_pts_seg = PointData(
    pts_semantic_mask=torch.tensor([1, 1, 0]),
    pts_instance_mask=torch.tensor([0, 0, -1]),
)

# 5) 观察契约内容
print(data_sample)                       # 分层 repr（序列化结果）
print('字段列表:', data_sample.keys())    # data fields 的键
print('元信息键:', data_sample.meta_keys())
print('框数量:', len(data_sample.gt_instances_3d))
print('sample_idx:', data_sample.get('sample_idx'))
```

**需要观察的现象**：

1. `print(data_sample)` 会输出 `<Det3DDataSample(META INFORMATION ... DATA FIELD ...)>` 的嵌套结构，`gt_instances_3d`、`pred_instances_3d`、`gt_pts_seg` 各占一段——与源码 docstring L72-L94 展示的格式完全一致。
2. `keys()` 只包含 data fields（如 `gt_instances_3d`），而 `sample_idx` 要用 `meta_keys()`/`get('sample_idx')` 才能拿到——metainfo 与 data fields 是两个独立分区。
3. `len(data_sample.gt_instances_3d)` 返回 3：`InstanceData` 的长度即实例数。

**预期结果**：脚本能无报错运行，`pred_instances_3d.scores_3d` 与 `labels_3d` 长度一致（`InstanceData` 的同长约束）。具体打印数值属「示例代码」输出，**待本地验证**。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么点云本身（`BasePoints` 对象）不作为 `Det3DDataSample` 的字段，而是放在 `inputs['points']` 里？

**答案**：`Det3DDataSample` 描述的是「标注与预测」这类随批次变化的监督/输出信息；点云是模型的直接输入张量，`Pack3DDetInputs` 会把它降维成裸 tensor 放进 `inputs`（见 [formating.py:L144-L146](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L144-L146)：`results['points'].tensor`）。只有「点级标注/预测」（掩码）才进 data_sample 的 `gt_pts_seg`/`pred_pts_seg`。

**练习 2**：`pts_pred_instances_3d` 与 `pred_instances_3d` 什么时候用前者？

**答案**：多模态任务（`use_lidar=True, use_camera=True`）。此时点云分支和图像分支各产出一套 3D 预测，分别写入 `pts_pred_instances_3d` 与 `img_pred_instances_3d` 以便区分；单一模态任务统一写 `pred_instances_3d`（依据 docstring L34-L48）。

**练习 3**：`Det3DDataSample` 里哪个字段不是 `InstanceData`/`PointData`，类型是什么？

**答案**：`eval_ann_info`，类型是 `dict` 或 `None`（docstring L51-L52），存数据集原始标注，供在线评估使用。

### 4.2 读写机制：property 三件套与 set_data / get

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`Det3DDataSample` 没有普通的 `__init__` 参数列表，所有字段都通过 **property（属性）三件套**——getter、setter、deleter——来读写。这样设计有两个目的：

1. **类型防线**：setter 内部调用 `set_field(value, '_xxx', dtype=InstanceData)`，赋值时立刻断言类型，把「塞错容器」的错误从「训练到一半才崩」提前到「赋值那一行」。
2. **下划线隔离**：真实数据存在 `_gt_instances_3d` 这类私有字段里，`gt_instances_3d` 只是访问入口，避免用户绕过检查直接改内部状态。

更底层的通用读写由 MMEngine 的 `BaseDataElement` 提供：`set_data(dict)` 批量写、`get(key, default)` 安全读、`set_metainfo(dict)` 写元信息区。mmdet3d 自己的代码两种风格都在用。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
写入一条 3D 真值：
data_sample.gt_instances_3d = InstanceData(...)
    → property setter
    → self.set_field(value, '_gt_instances_3d', dtype=InstanceData)
    → 断言 value 是 InstanceData，登记进 _data_fields

批量写入（分割后处理风格）：
data_sample.set_data({'pred_pts_seg': PointData(...), ...})
    → 逐键走 setattr，落到对应分区

读取：
data_sample.gt_instances_3d      # 属性风格
data_sample['gt_instances_3d']   # 下标风格（KittiMetric 就这么用）
data_sample.get('sample_idx')    # 带默认值的读

删除：
del data_sample.gt_instances_3d  → deleter 删私有字段并注销登记
```

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `gt_pts_seg` 的 setter 里 `dtype` 是 `PointData` 而 `gt_instances_3d` 是 `InstanceData`？

**答案**：两者数据形态不同——实例级数据（N 个框/标签）要求同长为 N，适合 `InstanceData`；点级数据（每个点一个标签）要求长度等于点数且全部一维，适合 `PointData`。setter 的 `dtype` 就是把这种区分固化成运行时检查。

**练习 2**：`data_sample.gt_instances_3d = xxx` 与 `data_sample.set_data({'gt_instances_3d': xxx})` 效果一样吗？

**答案**：一样。`set_data` 内部逐键走 setattr，最终仍会命中 property setter 的类型断言；分割后处理代码（segmentors/base.py:159）与属性赋值（formating.py:243）是同一机制的两种写法。

**练习 3**：如果想让一个自定义字段（比如 `my_heatmap`）进 data_sample，直接 `data_sample.my_heatmap = tensor` 可以吗？

**答案**：可以。`Det3DDataSample` 继承的 `BaseDataElement` 允许动态添加任意 data field；只有 docstring 里声明的那些字段才有强类型断言。但更稳妥的做法是放进 `InstanceData`/`PointData` 内部（如 `pred_pts_seg.pts_semantic_mask`），保持「一层容器一层含义」的结构。

### 4.3 PointData：点级标注与预测的容器

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`InstanceData` 的世界是「一个实例一行」；`PointData` 的世界是「一个点一行」。3D 语义分割任务里，一帧 10 万个点各有各的语义标签和实例编号，这些一维、等长的数组需要一个专门容器——这就是 `PointData`。它在 `Det3DDataSample` 中占据 `gt_pts_seg` 与 `pred_pts_seg` 两个字段。

`PointData` 的两条铁律（docstring 明确写出）：所有 data field 必须**都是一维的**、且**长度相同**（都等于点数）。这使它能像张量的第一维那样被整体索引。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
写入：point_data.pts_semantic_mask = tensor(N,)   → __setattr__ 校验有 __len__
索引：point_data[bool 掩码 / LongTensor / 切片 / int]
    → __getitem__ 对每个字段并行取同一批索引，返回新 PointData
长度：len(point_data) = 第一个 data field 的长度
```

`__getitem__` 是 `PointData` 最有意思的部分：无论传入布尔掩码、索引张量、切片还是整数，它都会**对容器内所有字段施加同一次筛选**，返回一个携带相同 metainfo 的新 `PointData`。这个能力和 `InstanceData` 的按实例筛选同源——数据增强或后处理中「只保留前景点」时，一条索引语句就能同步裁剪语义掩码与实例掩码。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**类定义与官方范例**。[mmdet3d/structures/point_data.py:L14-L46](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/structures/point_data.py#L14-L46)：docstring 给出最小示例——100 个点的 `PointData`，`point_data[10:60]` 切片后长度变为 50，随后补写 `pts_semantic_mask`/`pts_instance_mask` 两个 `(100,)` 张量。

**长度定义**。[mmdet3d/structures/point_data.py:L156-L161](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/structures/point_data.py#L156-L161)：`__len__` 返回第一个 data field 的长度，空容器返回 0。

**实践目标**：体验 `PointData` 的「并行筛选」能力——用一个布尔掩码同时裁剪两个字段。

```python
from mmdet3d.structures import PointData

    pts_instance_mask=torch.randint(-1, 3, (n,)))
```

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`PointData` 为什么把 `pts_instance_mask` 和 `pts_semantic_mask` 设计成同长？

**答案**：两者都按「点」对齐——第 i 个元素的语义类别与实例编号描述的是同一个点。同长约束让 `pd[keep]` 这类一次索引就能保持两个字段的对应关系不乱。

**练习 2**：docstring 里说「未来可能把 instance 级信息移到 `gt_instances_3d`」，这句话暗示 `PointData` 当前还临时承担了什么？

**答案**：它还临时存放 `instances_labels`、`instances_scores` 这类实例级字段（见 [point_data.py:L23-L26](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/structures/point_data.py#L23-L26)），按数据形态这些本应属于 `InstanceData`，官方注释承认这是历史包袱。

**练习 3**：`pd[3]`（整数索引）返回什么？

**答案**：返回只包含第 3 个点的新 `PointData`——L95-L100 把整数 `3` 改写为 `slice(3, None, len(pd))`（步长取容器长度，因此实际只命中索引 3 一个元素），字段仍是一维张量而不是降维成标量，源码注释称这是「keep the dimension」。

### 4.4 data_sample 的完整生命周期：生产、消费、评估

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

单看字段定义还不足以理解契约，必须看它在流水线三个环节里被谁写、被谁读：

- **生产**：`Pack3DDetInputs`（数据管线最后一个 transform，u3-l8 会专门精读）把增强后的 `results` dict 拆成 `inputs` 与 `data_samples`；
- **读写**：模型在 `loss` 模式读真值、在 `predict` 模式写预测；
- **消费**：评估器把 `pred_instances_3d` 与 `sample_idx` 收进结果列表。

理解这条链路后，你读任何检测器/评估器代码都能立刻对上「它在碰契约的哪个字段」。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
pack_single_results(results) 的分流规则（formating.py）：
  INPUTS_KEYS       ('points','img')        → inputs
  INSTANCEDATA_3D_KEYS (gt_bboxes_3d 等)    → gt_instances_3d（去掉 gt_ 前缀）
  INSTANCEDATA_2D_KEYS (gt_bboxes 等)       → gt_instances
  SEG_KEYS          (pts_*_mask 等)         → gt_pts_seg
  meta_keys         (sample_idx 等 38 项)   → data_sample.set_metainfo

预测写入（detectors/base.py）：
  head 产出 results_list（每个元素键名 bboxes_3d/scores_3d/labels_3d，
  由 bbox3d2result 统一组装）
  → add_pred_to_datasample 逐样本写入
    data_sample.pred_instances_3d / data_sample.pred_instances

评估消费（kitti_metric.py）：
  for data_sample in data_samples:
      读 data_sample['pred_instances_3d'] → 逐字段 .to('cpu')
      读 data_sample['sample_idx']（来自 metainfo）
      存入 self.results，最终由 compute_metrics 换算 AP
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

**字段分流的「路由表」**。[mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py:L50-L62](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L50-L62) 定义四组键名单：`INPUTS_KEYS`、`INSTANCEDATA_3D_KEYS`、`INSTANCEDATA_2D_KEYS`、`SEG_KEYS`——4.4.2 流程图里的分流规则就是查这四张表。[L64-L80](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L64-L80) 的 `meta_keys` 默认值列出约 38 个元信息键（`lidar2img`、`box_type_3d`、`sample_idx`、`pcd_scale_factor`……），相当于契约 metainfo 区的官方清单。

**生产现场**。[mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py:L194-L221](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L194-L221)：先 `new` 出 `Det3DDataSample()` 与三个空容器（`InstanceData`×2 + `PointData`），再按 `meta_keys` 从 results（含 `images`/`lidar_points` 嵌套 dict 的兼容分支）收集元信息调用 `set_metainfo`。[L223-L245](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L223-L245)：遍历 `self.keys` 查路由表分发，注意 `gt_bboxes_3d` 进来时若不是框容器会被 `to_tensor` 转成裸张量（L184-L186），`gt_` 前缀被 `_remove_prefix` 剥掉（L84-L87）——所以契约里的键名是 `bboxes_3d` 而管线里的键名是 `gt_bboxes_3d`。最后 [L246-L255](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/formating.py#L246-L255) 写入 `eval_ann_info`（无则 `None`），返回 `dict(data_samples=..., inputs=...)`——这就是 DataLoader 拿到的最终形态。

**三模式入口**。[mmdet3d/models/detectors/base.py:L74-L91](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/detectors/base.py#L74-L91)：`forward` 按 `mode` 分发到 `loss`/`predict`/`_forward`；`predict` 分支还识别 `data_samples[0]` 是 list 的「测试时增强」情形（u7-l4 的伏笔）。

**训练消费**。[mmdet3d/models/detectors/single_stage.py:L56-L76](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/detectors/single_stage.py#L56-L76)：`loss(batch_inputs_dict, batch_data_samples)` 原封不动把整批 data_samples 传给 `bbox_head.loss`——真值的拆包发生在检测头内部（单元 5 精读 `get_targets` 时会看到它逐样本读 `gt_instances_3d`）。

**预测写入**。[mmdet3d/models/detectors/single_stage.py:L109-L113](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/detectors/single_stage.py#L109-L113) 把 head 的 `results_list` 交给 `add_pred_to_datasample`；真正写契约的是 [mmdet3d/models/detectors/base.py:L149-L152](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/detectors/base.py#L149-L152)：循环里两行赋值 `data_sample.pred_instances_3d = ...` 与 `data_sample.pred_instances = ...`，缺哪一侧就用空 `InstanceData()` 补齐（L140-L147）。预测结果的统一键名来自 [mmdet3d/structures/ops/transforms.py:L51-L77](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/structures/ops/transforms.py#L51-L77) 的 `bbox3d2result`：返回 `dict(bboxes_3d=..., scores_3d=..., labels_3d=...)`（可选 `attr_labels`），全部先 `.to('cpu')`——评估器因此拿到的天然是 CPU 张量前的统一格式。

**评估消费**。[mmdet3d/evaluation/metrics/kitti_metric.py:L145-L168](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/evaluation/metrics/kitti_metric.py#L145-L168)：`process` 逐样本读 `data_sample['pred_instances_3d']`（下标写法等价于属性访问）、逐字段 `.to('cpu')`，再从 metainfo 读 `data_sample['sample_idx']` 作为对齐真值的钥匙，最终append 进 `self.results`，供 `compute_metrics`（L170 起）换算 AP。

**官方「范本数据」**。[mmdet3d/testing/model_utils.py:L124-L148](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/testing/model_utils.py#L124-L148)：mmdet3d 给单测造假数据的函数就是按契约组装——`InstanceData` 装 `bboxes_3d`+`labels_3d` 赋给 `gt_instances_3d`，`PointData` 装 `pts_instance_mask`/`pts_semantic_mask` 赋给 `gt_pts_seg`，metainfo 里放 `box_type_3d`。自己写测试或调试脚本时照抄这个结构即可。

**答案**：`Pack3DDetInputs` 在收集 metainfo 时写入（`meta_keys` 默认清单含 `sample_idx`，formating.py:L73；写入点在 L199-L221 的 `set_metainfo`）。数据集类的 `parse_data_info` 先在 results dict 里提供它（单元 3 展开）。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `Det3DDataSample` 继承 mmdet 的 `DetDataSample`，用 property 三件套声明 `gt_instances_3d`/`pred_instances_3d`/`pts_pred_instances_3d`/`gt_pts_seg` 等字段，setter 的 `dtype` 断言就是契约的运行时防线。
- 实例级数据装 `InstanceData`（N 实例同长），点级数据装 `PointData`（N 点同长、全一维），`eval_ann_info` 是唯一的裸 dict 字段。
- metainfo 与 data fields 是两个独立分区：`sample_idx`、`box_type_3d`、`lidar2img` 等元信息由管线写入、由预处理器增补（`batch_input_shape`/`pad_shape`），全流程共享。
- 生命周期三步：`Pack3DDetInputs.pack_single_results` 按 four 张键名路由表生产 `dict(inputs, data_samples)`；模型 `loss` 模式读真值、`predict` 模式经 `add_pred_to_datasample` 写预测；评估器用 `data_sample['pred_instances_3d']` 与 `sample_idx` 消费结果。
- `gt_` 前缀在打包时被剥掉，因此真值容器与预测容器内部字段同名（`bboxes_3d`/`labels_3d`），读写对称；`bbox3d2result` 保证所有检测头的预测键名统一。
- 读写 API 三套等价通道：属性赋值（触发类型断言）、`set_data`（批量）、`set_metainfo`（元信息区）；`get`/`keys()`/`in` 用于安全读取。
